articleTitle: Experimental Study of a Soft Pneumatic Actuator for the Application of Robotic Gripper
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Soft bending actuators are being used in many applications such as in soft robotics and medical devices due to their compliant behavior and safe interaction. These soft actuators are mainly actuated by pneumatic pressure because of cleaner and safer operations while dealing with delicate objects and human. A soft pneumatic actuator (SPA) with multi-chambered structure is more efficient than a single chamber SPA. In this paper, a multi-chambered SPA is designed and studied experimentally. The designed SPA is fabricated using two different soft hyperelastic materials namely, Ecoflex-0030 and Ecoflex-0050. The fabrication process utilized the 3D printing and casting techniques. From the experimental studies, it is found that the SPA fabricated using Ecoflex-0050 shows more uniform bending. Therefore, this SPA is further utilized for developing a soft pneumatic gripper for the robotic application. Three fingers of Ecoflex-0050 SPA are used for the soft robotic gripper, which is tested experimentally for handling delicate objects. From the experiments, it has been observed that the developed SPA is able to grasp and hold objects of different shapes and sizes with a load carrying capacity of approximately 650 gm.

articleTitle: Wavelet Based Enhanced Fault Detection Scheme for A Distribution System Embedded with Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Nowadays, Electric Vehicle (EV) technology is gaining pace with the modern requirement of limiting the fossil fuel consumption and greenhouse gas emission. However, such EVs require charging stations which are to be installed in the Distribution System (DS) and may be connected with different converter topologies as well as control techniques. Further, the current during the fault may be modulated due to the adopted control and protection circuits of the converters. When the fault occurs in the charging station, in case the fault is not cleared from the charging station, the backup should be provided by the detection of fault using the conventional protection technique: over current relay. Since the fault current is limited at the charging station, the backup relay may fail to detect the fault, which relies on change in current. Hence, development of a new technique is inevitable for fault detection if the DS is connected to the charging station. In this work, the wavelet transform-based scheme is proposed to enhance fault detection in the presence of battery charging station in DS. A charging station connected to 11 kV, 50 Hz AC substation is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK and results show the proposed method efficiently detects the fault in the DS.

articleTitle: Optimization of Wind-Hydro Hybrid Energy System for Stability Analysis by Using Different Types of Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: In conventional times due to presence of fossil fuels there were various challenges during the production of electricity. So various renewable energy sources have been introduced for achieving continuous and reliable power with less harmonics problem through hybrid connected mode For improving output power characteristics of hybrid energy system two energy sources such as wind turbine and hydro energy system have been integrated for improving power quality and stability. This paper deals with integration of wind turbine and hydro energy system in order to improve the performance of hybrid energy system in terms of stability. There are various controllers which have been compared and obtained optimal solution by using hybrid optimization technique under MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: Closed Loop Control of Brushless DC Motor by Various Controllers for Lightweight EVs
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: BLDC (Brushless Direct Current) motors are becoming an increasingly popular choice for Electric Vehicles (EVs) especially lightweight EVs such as two and three wheelers which form a major portion of vehicles on Indian roads. BLDC motors have similar traits as that of DC motors without the issue of loss in brush and commutator. The factors which are responsible for the popularity of BLDC motors are high reliability, high efficiency, high starting torque, and high durability. But it also suffers from issues like electromagnetic torque ripple, acoustic noise, and flux ripple, with torque ripple being the major one. To overcome these problems, research in control techniques of BLDC motors is being done. Closed loop control is an effective way to enhance control and reduce ripple. This paper studies and compares the behavior of the BLDC motor in closed-loop operation using PI, PID and cascade controllers. MATLAB/ SIMULINK 2016 software is used to perform simulations.

articleTitle: Study and Design of DC-DC LLC Full Bridge Converter for Electric Vehicle Charging Application
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This article mainly focuses on the study, design and operating frequency range aspects of high frequency based resonant LLC full bridge DC-DC converter for onboard battery charging application of EVs (electric vehicles). This suggested DC-DC LLC converter has low switching loss due to soft switching and hence high-efficiency because ZVS (Zero Voltage Switching) is used to turnon the MOSFET Switches, and ZCS (Zero Current Switching) is used to turnoff the rectifier diode. In this converter, a single high-frequency transformer is used to step down the voltage level suitable for battery charging, whose primary is connected to the resonant tank circuit and secondary is connected to the bridge rectifier. Fast charging method utilizes the CC (constant current)-CV (constant voltage) charging modes. Battery charging operation first uses the CC mode of charging, and ends with the CV mode of charging. This paper describes the principle of operation, design analysis of the converter, battery charging, and simulation results analysis of the suggested 1kW LLC resonant full bridge converter. The proposed model offers the advantages like, better voltage regulation at light load conditions, simple close-loop control, and soft switching benefit to minimize the losses and thereby maximize efficiency. The model was tested using the MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: A Seven-Level Switched Capacitor-Based RSC-MLI Topology with Suppressed Inrush Currents for Grid-Connected Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: A pre-requisite of an efficient inverter topology with less device count and limited dc source requirements has led to the developed of the switched capacitor based reduced switch count (RSC) multilevel inverters (MLI). Most often, switched capacitor (SC) topologies involves a single dc source switched in series/parallel with multiple capacitors such that it promotes the voltage-boosting ability with limited device count. However, switching energized capacitor in series to the dc-source produces high in-rush currents, which further increases the device current ratings. Also, the extreme reduction in device count restricted the switching redundancies effected the DC voltage balancing ability. Thus, the most popular SC topologies produces either produces high-rush currents or suffers with limited redundancies. Thus, this paper aims to discuss the features and limitations of most popular SC-based RSC-MLI configurations and then proposes a modified switched capacitor configuration with reduced in-rush currents, self-balancing and voltage-boosting ability.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power and High Noise Immunity Schmitt Triggers
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: In comparison to conventional Schmitt triggers, this paper offers a novel Schmitt trigger that provides low power and increased noise immunity. The power of the intended Schmitt trigger is reduced by employing low-power approaches, and noise immunity (i.e., increment in hysteresis width) is improved by raising the W/L ratio of the feedback MOSFET. Schmitt triggers have been realized on 90 nm CMOS technology and the results have been compared to conventional Schmitt triggers. Proposed Schmitt trigger 1 consumes <tex>$4.7\mu\mathrm{W}$</tex> with hysteresis width of 290 mV, whereas, Schmitt trigger 2 consumes <tex>$16.6\mu\mathrm{W}$</tex> with increased hysteresis width 934 mV.

articleTitle: Modelling and Analysis of a PFC Based EV Battery Charger Using Cuk-SEPIC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This article has presented an isolated bridgeless (BL) Cuk-single-ended primary inductor converter (SEPIC) converter for a mono-stage electric vehicles (EV) battery charger. The suggested charger's design ensures fundamental power factor correction (PFC) ac mains in discontinuous conduction mode. When employed for positive and negative cycles, the suggested architecture performs more effectively while using less components than the BL Cuk converter design. The merging of the CUK and SEPIC converter throughout each individual half cycle is to responsible for this. In comparison to the SEPIC converter utilized for both cycles, the output current is also smoothed by the inclusion of an output inductor at the Cuk converter side.

articleTitle: Mitigation Law against Time-delay based Cyber Intrusion Uncertainty in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Automatic frequency regulation (LFC) is a power system basic operational task that is commonly used for frequency regulation to obtain zero mismatch power deviation. Due to use of advanced technology, cyber intrusions are becoming a more serious threat towards safe operation of power system. After time delay intrusions, it in adequate to send accurate measurement data to control center within time range. This attack causes a disruption in the grid by manipulating the rate of change of frequency (ROF). Hence, a robust sliding mode controller (SMC) is developed against constant and varying time delay cyber intrusions and load patterns. The deviations in state trajectories guarantee to minimize the negative impact of delay attack vulnerabilities on grid state trajectories. It achieves minimum time characteristics simultaneously such as over/undershoot, settling time even in presence of delay attack vulnerabilities in LFC problem.

articleTitle: BigSync: Big Data Analytics For Synchrophasors
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Big Data Analytics For Synchrophasors (BigSync) is an offline engineering analysis software solution developed at Indian Institute of Technology Palakkad. The software solution allows the user to do post-event analysing utilising synchrophasor measurements of the power system. The software package includes applications such as signal trending, angle difference monitoring, event detection, transient stability prediction, fault diagnosis and inertia distribution monitoring. This paper details the applicability of offline engineering software solutions in operationalizing wide area measurement system(WAMS) solutions in the control room. Further, the applications integrated in BigSync are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Single-Band Ultrathin Polarization-insensitive Metamaterial Absorber for X-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This article introduces the ultrathin polarization-independent Metamaterial-based Absorber for the X-band (8-12 GHz) frequency range applications. The suggested shape of the unit cell contains four squares that are connected to each other. The presented unit cell design of a dual copper-coated FR-4 substrate is printed on the upper surface with a thickness of 1.6 mm. The simulated structure gives one absorption peak at the 9.572 GHz frequency range. The proposed square shape structure gives the perfect absorption of 99.88% at 9.572 GHz frequency. The imitated result illustrates the Metamaterial Absorber accede polarization-insensitive property. It has potential applications like active sensors (satellite), aeronautical navigation, radio-determination, radiolocation in civil, and radiolocation in the military. The formation of the design is polarization-independent for all incident angles. The depth of the proposed structure is very compact as compared to earlier designs.

articleTitle: Critical Clearing Time Revisited in an Inverter Dominated Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Energy generation is stepping on to the integration of more renewable sources as it is environment friendly and poses less ecological impact. Practical feasibility of such technologies has to be studied well before it is implemented on a system. Large scale integration of Renewable Energy Sources (RES) will reduce the total system inertia and can have adverse effects on power system transient stability. The objective of this paper is to find the impact of renewable energy penetration on one of the power system stability indicators called critical clearing time (CCT). The study is carried out on the well known IEEE 9 bus system considering different penetration of type-IV wind turbine generators (WTG). CCT is calculated for different fault locations using Dynamic Security Assessment Tools (DSA Tools) software of Powertech Labs. Furthermore, the correlation between inertia distribution index (IDI) and CCT is also explored. The results shows that the RES can have positive as well as negative impact on CCT.

articleTitle: Design of IoT Gateway and DSM Implementation in an Educational Institution
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: In the smart grid era, demand side management (DSM) contributes as an enduring research topic. Advancements in technologies and soaring energy demand in building paved the way for developing a quality Building Energy Management (BEM) approach. It promotes the effective utilization of available energy sources to meet escalating energy cravings. To the best of our knowledge sustainable works are reported mostly for residential and commercial buildings and less attention is paid to educational institutions. The scope of the study is to present a strategic DSM technique and to publish data collected from smart energy meters to multiple users at the remote end. This feasible study investigates the load pattern of Thiagarajar college of engineering's Electrical and electronics engineering department, Madurai, Tamil Nadu in specific. Owing to DSM implementation, machine learning-based time series classification is done. The results were found to help frame the Lab schedules and also reduce the probable possibility of maximum demand reach.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Graded channel and Dual-Metal Gate-Stack DG MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: The design of CMOS circuits employing nanoscale MOSFETs has grown extremely complex in recent years due to new obstacles such as mobility deterioration and short channel effects in device modeling. Gate and channel engineering alleviate these obstacles while improving carrier mobility, leading to better drain current and transconductance. The influence of Channel and Gate engineering techniques on the properties of multi-gate MOS devices is explored and described in this study. This manuscript includes a comprehensive investigation of the effect of metal gate work functions and Graded channel on symmetric double-gate MOS device using two-dimensional simulation tools. The results indicate that the proposed Graded channel and Dual-Metal Gate-Stack DG MOSFET has reduced leakage current and various short channel effects. It shows better analog RF parameters as compared to single metal conventional MOS device.

articleTitle: Novel Current Based Unit Protection Scheme for Transmission Line Connected to The Inverter Based DG
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Addition of Photo Voltaic Based sources to the electrical grid has reduced the carbon emission from coal-based thermal generation and also the line losses as they are included in distribution system(DS). However, location and control schemes of DG modulate the fault current at the relay location. Further, an investigation on traditional current protection schemes with DGs reveals, a new protection scheme is essential for fault detection. The proposed method uses both ends current to compute the phase current ratio to detect fault with IBDGs. The threshold area is chosen considering the improvement of dependability, sensitivity, security, and reliability of relay. Simulation of a 100 kW PV array connected to a 25 kV, 60 Hz grid system in PSCAD/EMTDC reveals the proposed method has improved performance in detecting the internal fault.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network models for classification of significant attributes to predict Pre-Diabetes Mellitus
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Hyperglycemia is a chronic condition associated with Pre-diabetes mellitus. It could lead to many health issues. According to recent increases in morbidity, the number of diabetic victims across the world is expected to reach 642 million by 2040, or one out of every ten persons. Without a doubt, this alarming number requires a lot of attention. However, detection of pre-diabetes condition will help the subjects to take precautions measures before head of actual diabetic condition. The Deep learning methods have shown its application in many facets of medical health. Therefore, Deep neural network (DNN) based system is proposed in the present work to detect pre diabetes using photoplethysmography (PPG) signal and other physiological signals. A dataset from 217 participants is used for experimentation. The obtained results are also compared with various machine learning (ML) methods. Further the results are also validated using 5-fold cross validation method. The result shows that DNN model performed well in the prediction of Pre-diabetes mellitus with 99.31% accuracy despite having fewer adjustable parameters. This obtained results shows that the proposed method can alert the subjects before onset of diabetes.

articleTitle: Bond Graph Model-based Control of a Wheeled Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Mobile robots have applications in many areas for transportation of goods and passengers. Mobile robots with wheels for the ground applications are the most commonly used class of mobile robots. Wheeled mobile robots may have one or more number of wheels according to the requirement of a particular application. In the present paper, a two-wheeled differential drive mobile robot is analyzed based on its dynamic model. The dynamic model of the robot is developed using a graphical modeling tool called bond graph, which enables to build a multi-domain model of the mobile robot by considering the chassis and motors' dynamics. Furthermore, the developed bond graph model is utilized to develop a model-based control strategy for the control of the mobile robot by regulating its orientation and position. Indeed, a model-based controller performs better to avoid various disturbances such as parametric uncertainties. Finally, to verify the developed model, simulation of the dynamic model is performed using a software called SYMBOLS, which is dedicated for the bond graph modeling and simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modelling of Multilevel Inverter for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This article aims to introduce compact, efficient and reliable multilevel inverter (MLI) design to implement for various applications such driving ac motors of electric vehicles and also in the area of renewable energy like solar PV. The analyzed MLI is having simple and easy switching technique and provides four times the output voltage gain. Solar panel provided with perturb and observe (P&O) based MPPT algorithm to track maximum power and hence provides the stable and reliable dc output voltage which is then fed to single input multiple output boost converter. The output of boost converter acts as the input source of multilevel inverter. Analyzed multilevel quadruple nine level switched capacitor based multilevel inverter having lesser number of power electronics components and hence requires lesser driver circuits as well as lesser voltage stress across the switches. When compared to other SC-MLI topologies and thus reduces the overall circuitry losses and hence increases efficiency and reliability of the analyzed MLI system.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Analysis of RES based Islanded Microgrid for Different Locations at Tamilnadu
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Recently, a main challenging issues for rural electrification and remote areas are having limited power consumption or without grid connection access. Especially, the global concerns towards weather changes, clean and sustainable energy system, reducing fuel costs, reliable renewable sources and environmental impact to assure the feasible energy demand. To accomplish this problem, this study examines a hybrid renewable energy source (RES) such as solar panel system, wind system, Battery System (BS), Diesel Generators system (DG) for a selected three off-grid locations such as Aralvaimozhi, Kamuthi, and Cuddalore in Tamil Nadu, India with different climate weather conditions. Additionally, fuel-based generator energy sources are designed, investigated and compared with hybrid RES to estimate the feasible solution in technical and economic indicators with the help of hybrid renewable source optimization model (HOMER) tool. Meanwhile, an optimal solution to find the sensitivity performance is covered with a help of specific parameters such as solar insolation level, wind speed, generator belongs to load follow strategy (LF), cycle charge (CC) and combined charge (CD) for the proposed system. Therefore, the obtained optimal behaviour for the hybrid solar-wind speed with battery, DG source is compared over the selected locations to find the energy efficient and cost configuration. Consequently, the designed system gives lowest level of cost of net present cost, energy cost and air pollution reduction in carbon as well as fuel utilization. Finally, the consequence of this present study project that renewable energy potential for each location for the proposed hybrid system should be viable and feasible.

articleTitle: High Efficient Quality of Video Compression using Variational Autoencoders in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: The past few years researchers are rising dominance of deep learning and artificial intelligence in huge range of various applications like image and video compression. The paper provides a deep concept over for highly loss video compression model. In the existing neural networks of video encoding presence of quantity and level of redundancy provides unique problems. The ELBO utilized in variational autoencoders is strongly related to the rate distortion loss, which the autoencoder and prior are jointly trained to reduce. Although proposed method is straightforward, in this paper discover that it beats cutting-edge learning video compression networks interpolation. The work where systematically assess key design decisions, including the type of autoregressive prior and the usage of frame-based or spatio-temporal autoencoders. And also provide three modifications to the fundamental concept that highlight its advantages over more traditional compression techniques. In this paper proposed semantic compression, which trains the model to devote more bits to important objects. This work investigates the proposed multimodal compression, where it will presents how well our approach works when it comes to combining different modalities that have been collected by unconventional imaging sensors, such quad cameras. And finalize that approach makes unique video compression applications possible that were not possible with conventional codecs. Finally, at the end of the work in our multimodal compression studies significantly improves compression performance with the PSNR of 48. For future scope of work, a simple decoder can recreate videos with sufficient quality without compromising classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Mitigation of False Data based Cyber Intrusion Uncertainty in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Due to use of advanced technologies, cyber intrusions are becoming a more serious threat towards safe operation of power system. Thus, it enables cyber-physical based system stability and security issues in LFC problem. The cyber physical network is used to send accurate measurement data to control center. However, it inevitably leads to increase physical false information injection integrity type of cyber-attack vulnerability at large extend. This attack causes a disruption in the grid by manipulating the rate of change of frequency (ROF). Hence, an optimal linear quadratic regulator (LQR) law is developed against false information injection (FDI) integrity type of cyber intrusions and load patterns. The deviations in state trajectories guarantee to minimize the negative impact of FDI intrusion vulnerabilities on grid state trajectories. It achieves minimum time characteristics simultaneously such as over/undershoot, settling time even in presence of FDI intrusion vulnerabilities in LFC problem.

articleTitle: Low Power Architecture of 4-bit Odd Parity Generator/Checker Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Using the Modified Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) approach, a 4-bit Odd Parity Generator/Checker is constructed in this study using CMOS XNOR and CMOS XOR gates. The CMOS XNOR Gate is also realized using Conventional, Complementary Pass Transistor Logic (CPL), Dual Pass Transistor Logic (DPL) & Modified Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) techniques out of which MGDI emerges out to be the most efficient one. The simulation of the above techniques at 180nm VLSI Technology shows that MGDI technique consumes 74.47%,16.21%,33.83% less power than conventional, CPL and DPL techniques respectively. Two new basic gate realization techniques have also been proposed namely CPL-Hybrid (CPLH) and DPL-Hybrid. CPLH technique shows 3.13% less average power dissipation and 16.54% less average propagation delay than MGDI technique in 25KHz to 100MHz frequency range.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Isolated Bidirectional Converter with Center Tapped Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Bidirectional DC-DC transformer converters with center tapped circuit are useful in low voltage (LV), high current application. In terms of volume, price, and efficiency, it is appealing. However, switches connected to the center-tapped circuit might be see a voltage spike under parameter variation of the resonant components, when synchronous rectification (SR) is not done properly. This happens because forceful stoppage of the circulating current path. To solve this, numerous studies using SR technology with hardware sensing for unidirectional application have been conducted. The SR technique with hardware sensing is difficult since the SR bridge needs to be changed under various power directions. This article suggests a center-tapped transformer bidirectional dc-dc converter architecture. To prevent turn-off voltage spikes, In LV side, active clamp circuits made of capacitors connected in series with auxiliary switches are placed in parallel with the power switches. In this topology, switches are turn-on at zero voltage switching (ZVS). Due to this, we can minimize the electromagnetic interference (EMI) and switching losses.

articleTitle: Analysis of Three Area Interconnected Wind-integrated Multiterminal HVDC Network under AC and DC Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: The extensive inclusion of power electronics devices has escalated the need to curb the rapidly rising dc fault current as quickly as possible. Because it can damage the submodules of the voltage source converter (VSC). Failure of the submodule can damage the converters of the High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission system. This may further result into large power outage if not resolved quickly. So, a suitable coordinated control strategy and protection scheme has to be designed by understanding the system's behavior. For this, a three-terminal HVDC network has been modeled to analyze the impact of both AC and DC faults developed in the system. The system is modeled under MATLAB platform and various AC, as well as DC side faults, are simulated to analyze the current and voltage signature with respect to fault conditions.

articleTitle: Tariff-aware Power Management Scheme for Economic Operation of Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are becoming popular day by day because they lower the dependency on fossil fuels. A novel approach to building EV charging stations uses solar photovoltaic (SPV) integrated into the grid. Information on day-ahead grid electricity pricing is gathered using a forecasting system based on Nonlinear Autoregressive Neural Network (NARX). Later a price coefficient is added to further divide on-peak and off-peak grid electricity pricing. This paper proposes two different tariff-aware power management schemes for both on-peak and off-peak prices. It manages to provide a continuous power supply to the critical as well as EV loads. Both EV and the critical loads are able to receive a steady supply of electricity from the grid depending on tariff. The proposed scheme is validated using MATLAB Simulink 2020b.

articleTitle: Harmonic Compensation Method for Low-voltage Small-scale Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This paper presents a harmonic compensation method for low-voltage small-scale islanded microgrids, which is implemented using a harmonic observer. The proposed system includes a harmonic observer which helps to decompose the load current harmonics of the non-linear loads. In addition to the load current harmonic decomposition approach, a feed-forward control method is also proposed to reduce the voltage distortion in the islanded microgrid. The main feature of the proposed control system is the estimation of load-induced disturbances and their compensation. Analysis and simulation results are presented to verify the performance of the proposed compensation method.

articleTitle: Analysis on Bus Voltage with Optimal Placement and Size of PV System for Different Solar Radiation and Load Changes
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: The studies on DG placement and capacity have been broadly reported in last few years. The unbalanced low voltage (LV) distribution network leads to an increase in losses and instability in the system. This paper investigates the voltage distribution profile in the IEEE-37 bus network, for which optimal placement and size of PV installation has been formulated to minimize the installation cost. The analysis performed on voltage magnitude distribution throughout the network, suggests that it remains sensitive to either active or reactive power injection according to the locations and prevailing solar radiation profile.

articleTitle: On Sliding Mode based Event-Trigger Control of a Micro Arial Robot for Perching on Vertical Outdoor Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This article proposes an event-triggered based robust control approach for the perching application of a micro aerial robot. A finite time position tracking controller is developed. A recursive finite time stable manifold has been presented for the convergence of the error in finite time. Next, control laws for all the control inputs are derived from the designed stable sliding manifold. Furthermore, from the Lyapunov stability theory, periodic event-triggering conditions are derived to minimize resource utilization. The experimental results are presented to validate designed controller towards the application of environmental monitoring via perching of a micro aerial robot on vertical outdoor surface.

articleTitle: Image-based Foreign Object Detection using YOLO v7 Algorithm for Electric Vehicle Wireless Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: As problems like climate change, greenhouse emissions, etc. become common, Electric Vehicles (EVs) are now being looked at as an alternative. In order for EVs to succeed, numerous charging networks must be established in a user-friendly environment and the optimum charging solution must be selected. Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) System is an option that simplifies the battery charging process for EVs as it eliminates the need for annoying cables and ensures the user's safety. Inductive power transfer is currently the most popular and mature WPT technology, which uses magnetic fields for power transfer. In order to comply with transmission and safety criteria, Foreign Object Detection (FOD) is an essential module that has to be taken care of. Deep Learning (DL) has been successfully applied to various applications by using algorithms such as CNNs, You Only Look Once (YOLO), etc. In this work, a unique approach has been taken toward FOD by using DL, particularly the YOLO v7 algorithm. The pre-trained YOLO v7 algorithm has been further customized to detect (a) coins (b) screws and (c) paper clips as part of FOD and towards the end, Mean Average Precision of 97%, 93.1% precision, and 95.3% recall values have been achieved.

articleTitle: Impact of PLL Dynamics on Frequency Stability in Low Inertia Trending Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Due to the higher frequency fluctuation in the low-inertia trading power system, phase converter synchronization with the grid is a critical problem. A phase-locked loop (PLL) is a standard synchronous approach in grid-connected applications that shows robust performance under ideal conditions. However, a second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) filter-based synchronous reference frame PLL (SRF-PLL) is proposed to improve the steady-state stability during unbalanced and distorted grid conditions. The PLL parameters, such as the damping coefficient and natural frequency, are designed in such a way as to increase the PLL's locking time to correct high-frequency variations. The simulation is performed on the Matlab Simulink platform to verify the theoretical analysis. Finally, the whole experiment is implemented on an Industrial grade DSP to support the proposed system's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Abstrct Booklet ICPCES-2023
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)

articleTitle: An empirical study of PMU data based power system event detection techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: The interconnected power system as well as small-scale power system such as microgrids are exposed to numerous unexpected events, such as tripping, capacitor switching, and faults. Hence the detection of power system events obtains the significant role in system restoration, power control, and reliable operation. The study reported in this submission provides the brief description of the event detection techniques which are implemented using phasor measurement unit (PMU) data. The overview of the reported literature within the sight of the authors is lucidly presented with some key insights. The details of data utilized, performance metrics, simulation tool, and the methodology employed are provided so as to give the outline and possible features of the reported work.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems in a Commercial Building by Enhancing Renewable Resources using HOMER Software
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Integrating and expanding renewable energy resources on the customer's end is revolving as a hot trending topic especially in developing countries for sustainable energy trading. Owing to that, India welcomes the active participation of prosumers for self-utilization and to contribute to the local energy markets. The biggest challenge from the customer end is integrating renewable resources having intermittent nature due to adverse environmental factors. To mitigate the challenges of using highly dynamic renewable sources, a detailed investigation of the Hybrid Energy System (HES) is in need. The presented paper creates a proposal for upgrading the existing system – Quantanics Techserv private limited located in the Madurai district of Tamil Nadu, India. The system comprises four different energy resources namely solar PV panels as a renewable source, diesel generation, and battery storage as supporting supply systems along with grid supply from the state electricity board (Tamil Nadu Electricity Board - TNEB). The study mainly accounted to verify the feasibility of updating the existing PV system concerning location data and load traces using the Hybrid Optimization Model for Electric Renewables (HOMER) software. The optimal results are extracted based on economic and environmental aspects. This techno-economic analysis gives comparative results under two distinguished dispatch strategies (Load Following and Cycle charging). The optimal configuration for both existing and upgrading PV system is found with a minimum Net Price Cost (NPC) and Levelized Cost of Energy (COE) respectively.

articleTitle: Impact of Variable Fault Impedances during Symmetrical Fault in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: Symmetrical fault is the most severe fault in the power network. This occurs rarely however with equal amount of severe currents in the three phases. Now, in an active distribution network (ADN) shunt faults such as load fault or line tripping faults are observed to occur frequently due to uncertain penetration of distributed generated (DG) power from the distributed energy resources (DERs). The impact of different fault parameters such as phase voltages, phase angles and current flows due to symmetrical fault with variable fault impedance in ADN is noticeable. Hence, the analysis of symmetrical fault for different fault impedances are required to study in the ADN. In this work, the impact symmetrical fault with three fault impedances is taken into consideration including bolted fault in an ADN utilizing Power World Simulator. Moreover, the symmetrical fault is analyzed individually at different buses such as generator bus, load bus, and DG connected buses as available in the network to compare the severity of the fault and variation of the fault impedances at the different buses while measuring the fault parameters. The result analysis shows that the bolted fault has the highest severity on the ADN particularly at the DG connected load bus. It is also observed that when the fault impedance is increasing the severity of the symmetrical fault reduces in the network.

articleTitle: Resilience Analysis of Mesh-Grid Integrated Distribution Network using Bayes' Theorem
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: The inclusion of distributed energy resources (DERs) has transformed the traditional distribution network (DN) into active distribution network (ADN). The DERs are intermittent by nature leading to generation related uncertainties. Combined with frequent changing weather conditions and increasing load fluctuations, it has become even more important for the ageing system to attain resilience. In this paper, mesh-grid integrated ADN is used to demarcate the most sensitive region within system due to wind related uncertainties, which would have been a difficult task considering its geographical and topological spread. Although there are many methods to attain resilience, however mesh-grid integrated ADN is used for Bayesian analysis, to monitor performance of ADN. This novel method has the ability to integrate geographical information and uncertainty description coherently. Therefore, region-specific conditional dependency during uncertain events aids in better decision making by power system operators for enhance situational awareness (SA). Based on operational reliability indices obtained for different distributed generation (DG) and overhead (OH) line conditions, reconfiguration or back up diesel generator is used to attain resilience of the ADN.

articleTitle: Anti-windup Design for Uncertain Systems based on Guaranteed Cost Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This paper investigates the issue of Anti-windup (AW) control designed for uncertain continuous-time (CT) systems using guaranteed cost control (GCC) approach. AW compensator is added to a previously designed dynamic output feedback controller to sustain the above system in utter lack of saturation to eliminate the effects of input saturation. By utilizing the quadratic Lyapunov function, the condition of stability for closed-loop (CL) system is established. The proposed method confirms asymptotic stability of the system and also provides the upper-bound of performance index for CL systems. A convex optimization problem has been exacerbated by an effective AW compensator gain including guaranteed cost design difficulty. To demonstrate the utility of the proposed technique, an acceptable example is used.

articleTitle: Exponential Stability Criterion for State-space Interfered Discrete System through External Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Conference on Power, Control & Embedded Systems (ICPCES)
abstract: This article deals with stability investigation of state-space fixed-point discrete system using saturation nonlinearity and external interference. A criterion for exponential stability is proposed via a passivity-based approach for an externally interfered nonlinear discrete system. For the discrete system with saturation overflow nonlinearity, we have analyzed the passive behaviour under the effects of external interference and asymptotic stability with zero interference. A comparative study is made available with the previously reported result to highlight the worth and relaxed nature of the proposed work. The criterion developed is in linear matrix inequality (LMI) settings and therefore, numerically less complex. Numerical simulations are made available to showcase the productiveness of the obtained criterion.
